results.name: vault
results.reason: The exact current 2025-05-01 and latest GA 2026-05-15 Learn/REST schemas were compared. Both require location/properties and tenantId/sku; all declared literal enums, types, UUID, tags, retention range, network ACL values, and booleans are compatible. The 2026-05-15 change log reports no property changes.
results.migration: Possible: latest GA 2026-05-15 is newer than current 2025-05-01, and exact current/candidate schemas preserve every used attribute and accepted value.

findings.detail: Latest stable GA 2026-05-15 is newer than current 2025-05-01. Exact candidate schema retains all used fields and constraints; source literals A/standard, Deny/None, booleans, and retention 7 are compatible.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Original Bicep /name maps to required vaults/{vaultName} string path and inherited resource name; vaultName is a string parameter.

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: Original /location maps to required top-level location:string; supplied from string deployment-location parameter.

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: Original /tags maps to a tags object with additionalProperties:string in both schemas. The caller supplies the common string-valued tags map.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: Original /properties maps to VaultProperties; tenantId and sku are both required and supplied; the remaining used fields are verified individually.

usage.label: tenantId
usage.analysis: REST properties.tenantId is required string format uuid; subscription().tenantId supplies the subscription tenant UUID.

usage.label: sku
usage.analysis: REST properties.sku is required object; both required children family and name are supplied.

usage.label: family
usage.analysis: REST sku.family enum is ['A']; source literal A is allowed.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: REST sku.name enum is ['standard','premium']; source literal standard is allowed.

usage.label: enableRbacAuthorization
usage.analysis: REST properties.enableRbacAuthorization is boolean; literal true matches.

usage.label: enableSoftDelete
usage.analysis: REST properties.enableSoftDelete is boolean; literal true matches.

usage.label: softDeleteRetentionInDays
usage.analysis: REST properties.softDeleteRetentionInDays is int32; Learn documents range 7–90, and source literal 7 is the valid lower boundary.

usage.label: publicNetworkAccess
usage.analysis: REST properties.publicNetworkAccess is string (no enum constraint); Learn documents 'disabled' as blocking public internet access. Source literal Disabled expresses the same setting and is a string.

usage.label: networkAcls
usage.analysis: REST properties.networkAcls resolves to NetworkRuleSet; source supplies defaultAction and bypass, while other ACL lists are optional.

usage.label: defaultAction
usage.analysis: REST NetworkRuleSet.defaultAction enum is ['Allow','Deny']; source literal Deny is allowed.

usage.label: bypass
usage.analysis: REST NetworkRuleSet.bypass enum is ['AzureServices','None']; source literal None is allowed.

current.analysis: Exact current Learn reference and pinned openapi.json were read. VaultCreateOrUpdateParameters requires location and properties; VaultProperties requires tenantId (string/uuid) and sku. Sku requires family/name with enums A and standard/premium. NetworkRuleSet enum values, flags, retention int32, publicNetworkAccess string, and tags additionalProperties:string were checked against this declaration.

ga.analysis: Learn version selector lists 2026-05-15 as latest stable before 2026-06-01-preview. Complete fixed-commit tree contains stable vault openapi versions 2025-05-01, 2026-02-01, and 2026-05-15; 2026-05-15 is latest GA. Exact candidate schema preserves the current fields and constraints, and all source literals pass.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log entry 2026-05-15 explicitly reports no properties added, updated, or removed. Current and candidate schemas have matching constraints for all used properties; soft delete retention 7 remains within Learn documented 7–90 range.
